extName.message: Search Without AI: hide AI Overviews and ads for Google™
extName.description: Nombre en la Chrome Web Store y en chrome://extensions (máx. 75)

extDescription.message: Hide AI Overviews, ads and filler blocks on Google. See just the results with links. Free, no tracking.

masterOptionsDesc.message: Turn it off to pause everything without losing your settings.

optAiOverviewDesc.message: Removes the “AI Overview” box shown above the results.

optAiModeDesc.message: Removes the “AI Mode” tab and button.

optShoppingDesc.message: Removes product, price and store carousels. If you also hide maps and places, filters like “In stock” or “Open now” go too.

optPaaDesc.message: Removes the list of expandable questions.

optImagesDesc.message: Removes image boxes between results. The “Images” tab still works.

optPlacesDesc.message: Removes the “Places” block with the map and nearby businesses. Google Maps still works.

optForumsDesc.message: Removes the block of threads from Reddit, Quora and other forums. Regular results from those sites stay.

optRelatedDesc.message: Removes related-search suggestions, at the bottom of the page and inside results.

optNoticeDesc.message: A small notice tells you how many items were hidden and lets you see them.

sitesIntro.message: Results from these sites, and their subdomains, won’t appear.

sitesInvalid.message: That doesn’t look like a domain. Try something like pinterest.com.

sitesLimit.message: The list already has the maximum of $MAX$ sites.

advancedIntro.message: These options change the address of your searches. They start off; turn them on only if you know what they do.

optWebOnlyDesc.message: Opens your searches straight in Google’s “Web” view: just results with links.

webOnlyWarning.message: This mode also removes other panels, like info cards, maps, top stories or weather. Images, News, Videos, Maps and Shopping stay the same. While it’s on, the “All” tab takes you back to “Web”.

optBeforeDateDesc.message: Adds a date filter to show pages published before the day you choose.

beforeDateWarning.message: Google estimates each page’s date its own way: some pages without a clear date may disappear and some newer ones may slip in. If you pick another range under “Tools”, yours is kept.

beforeDateInvalid.message: Pick a date between September 4, 1998 and today.

statsLocalNote.message: This counter is stored only in your browser and is never sent anywhere.

dataDesc.message: Save your options and site list to a JSON file, or load them in another browser.

resetConfirm.message: All options will be restored and your blocked-site list will be emptied. The counter stays as is. Continue?

importError.message: Couldn’t read the file. Use a JSON file exported from this extension.

optionsSubtitle.message: Choose what to hide from your Google searches. Changes apply instantly, even in open tabs.

popupMainOptions.description: Título de la sección del popup

freeNote.message: Everything is free. Donating is optional.

donateLink.message: Find it useful? You can buy me a coffee ☕

donatePromptBody.message: This extension is free and will stay free. If it’s helped you, you can support it with a coffee. Totally optional.

reportHint.message: Opens GitHub in a new tab. You need a free account. Only what you write is sent.

trademarkNote.message: Independent extension, not affiliated with Google LLC. Google is a trademark of Google LLC.
trademarkNote.description: Atribución de marca exigida por la Chrome Web Store

madeBy.description: Crédito al pie del popup y de opciones

privacyNote.message: No tracking: no data is collected or sent. Your options are saved with Chrome sync.

noticeRegion.description: Etiqueta accesible del aviso en Google
